response.rationale: Tier B with 22 orders in 28 days is a moderately reliable read, supporting most of the +10% raise. However, the shrunk realised dROAS (1.87) sits ~16% below the 2.22 goal, so the raise rests on marginal-clearing logic rather than above-goal headroom; dampen modestly rather than fully trusting the mechanical step, while staying near 1.0 given the CLEARS verdict and guardrail clamp.
